ruling.recommended_action: Route to human safety review: preserve the trip GPS/telemetry (speed, harsh-braking/overtaking events, shoulder use) and the chat record; contact rider with RydeHELP safety path and 995 guidance if injured; take driver statement on record and assess Code of Conduct breach (abuse of rider in F6) separately from the driving allegation.
ruling.reasoning: Dispute type is safety and the complaint alleges dangerous driving — speeding, hard braking throughout and overtaking on the shoulder, with the rider stating she was frightened [F1][F2 ride data only show a normal 10.5 km / 15.9 min trip and cannot confirm or refute the driving-conduct allegation]. SAFE-2 therefore applies and no automatic ruling is made; the case goes to a human reviewer with the factual summary above. The safety screen also catches the driver's written statement [F6] describing the rider as "stupid" — hostile, insulting language aimed at the other party, which Ryde's Code of Conduct bars as abuse of any kind under SAFE-1, at least "suspected." Because the rider is the complainant, SAFE-1 is grounded mainly on the driver's own statement against her. Note this is not a route or fare case: actual distance is 10.5 km versus 10.6 km optimal (-0.1 km) and duration 15.9 min versus 16.5 min estimated, so there is no off-route segment to examine and no monetary dispute; amount is null. Profiles [F7][F8] are clean and decide nothing (profile facts can never decide a case alone). Nothing in the chat [F3][F4][F5] is a threat; the safety concern rests on the complaint's dangerous-driving allegation and the driver's abusive wording. Evidence for the driving allegation (speed/telemetry records) is not in the fact table, so a human must review it rather than rule. Human reviewer should apply SAFE-2 reporting path: 995 for medical need, driver's commercial motor insurance for claims, RydeHELP report.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety dispute (dangerous-driving allegation, SAFE-2) plus abusive language in the driver's statement aimed at the rider (SAFE-1); no automatic ruling issued, human reviewer to decide.
safety_basis: Complaint alleges speeding, hard braking throughout and overtaking on the shoulder (dangerous driving) — SAFE-2
Driver's written statement calls the rider "stupid": hostile/insulting language aimed at the other party, abuse under SAFE-1
